title: Setting different alert sound for missed readings and bg falling fast
body:
Is it possible to set different alert sounds for missed readings and bg falling fast?

In "_settings -> alarms and alerts -> missed reading alert_" there is no alarm sound config option.
There is in _"settings -> alarms and alerts -> other alerts -> alert sound"_ but it's both for missed readings and bg falling fast.

Since I often get disconnected from the blucon, which raises the missed readings alert, I'd like want to know if I just need to restart bluetooth/collector device, or rush for some sugar... :)

comments.body: When you choose a sound for Forecasted Low Alerts, the same sound is used for Missed Readings Alerts. Can we have independent sound selection for these as well, as users may rely on specific alert sounds to convey meaning.

If your Android is level 8 or higher, you can use notification channels to accomplish this.

Enable:
Settings -> Alarms and Alerts -> Glucose Alerts Settings -> Notification Channels

Now, you need to trigger the missed readings alert. To artificially cause that, just change the hardware data source to something non-existent.

After the alert is triggered, use Android settings to go to Settings -> Apps & Notifications -> xDrip+ -> Notifications
You should see a channel titled: bgMissedAlertChannel.
Tap on the following line (Missed reading Alert).
Now, you can customize your preferences including choosing the sound clip.
As of the 2025.03.11 release, the Missed Reading alert lets you choose a sound file dedicated to that alert.
